name: bicing_etl
description: Reads daily GCS files and loads into BigQuery bicing_raw.

parameters.name: project
parameters.label: GCP project ID
parameters.helpText: GCP project ID where Dataflow and BigQuery resources live.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.label: Raw GCS bucket name
parameters.helpText: Raw GCS bucket name without the gs:// prefix.

parameters.name: bq_dataset
parameters.label: BigQuery dataset
parameters.helpText: BigQuery dataset that contains the bicing_raw table.

parameters.name: date
parameters.label: Date to process
parameters.helpText: Date to process in America/Santiago local time e.g. 2026-05-21. Defaults to yesterday.
